title: /effort Slash Command + ultrathink Keyword — Interactive Reasoning Budget
version_introduced: v2.1.76 (/effort command); ultrathink keyword (exact version unclear, likely same)
redundancy_comparison: Registry has 'Effort Controls (API)' (four levels low/medium/high/max, API feature) and 'effort frontmatter' (v2.1.78+, for agent/skill definitions). The /effort slash command and ultrathink keyword are NOT documented in the registry.
description: Two related features for interactive reasoning budget control in Claude Code sessions: (1) /effort command: type in prompt box to cycle through Low/Medium/High/Max effort levels per session; visible in logo/spinner so you know what effort level is active. (2) ultrathink keyword: per-turn override that bumps effort to High for just the next response, then reverts to session default. The `ultrathink` keyword is a per-prompt escalation; `/effort` is a session-wide setting.

usage.effort_command: /effort — cycles Low/Medium/High/Max. Current level shown in spinner.
usage.ultrathink: Include 'ultrathink' in a prompt to temporarily bump effort to Max for that response only.
usage.works_during_response: As of v2.1.70, /effort works even while Claude is actively responding.

relationship_to_existing.api_effort_parameter: API-level parameter for programmatic invocations (heartbeat scripts). Different interface.
relationship_to_existing.effort_frontmatter: Static declaration in agent/skill definitions. Different interface.
relationship_to_existing.slash_command: Interactive runtime control for human users. NOT in registry.
relationship_to_existing.ultrathink: Per-turn keyword override. NOT in registry.

token_impact: Saves — Low/Medium effort levels reduce token usage for simple tasks; only use High/Max when needed
capability_expansion: Gives interactive sessions the same budget control as programmatic API calls. ultrathink keyword enables ad-hoc 'think harder' without a full mode switch.
integration_effort: Easy — built-in feature, no configuration needed. Registry update only.
integration_action: Update registry Reasoning section: add /effort slash command to the table; add ultrathink keyword note; clarify that effort has three interfaces (API param, frontmatter field, /effort slash command)

score.note: APPROVE for registry documentation update. Built-in feature, zero integration cost, fills genuine documentation gap.

recommended_action: FAST_TRACK — registry update to document /effort command and ultrathink keyword as distinct interfaces from API effort parameter and effort frontmatter.
